text:
incident-bot: PAGER: KV cache memory spike on hosted-runtime-prod (kv-cache-hosted-01). Memory climbed 42% -> 98% in ~3m. Alerts: OOM risk on inference workers. Prefetch throughput x100. Affected: hosted runtime (generation), some customers seeing 502/timeout. Paging @ops-oncall :rotating_light:
Priya Rao: ack, I'm looking at grafana and logs now. Any obvious recent deploys?
ops-oncall: I'm on it. No deploys in the last 30m. Looking at per-shard KV sizes — one shard shows continuous growth. Long prompts from a handful of sessions spiking prefix length.
Marco Li: I see continuous-batching windows ballooned to ~4k tokens for model-redwood-7b on several hosts. Prefetch appears to be rehydrating huge KV windows. Likely prefetch + batch-window config combo.
Samir Patel: Can we throttle prefetch or drop continuous batching for the model as a hotfix? Proposing temporary controls: set PREFETCH_MAX_SESSIONS=200, PREFETCH_RATE_LIMIT=50r/s and BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=2048 for the model route.
Priya Rao: Sounds good. Also flip eviction_policy to aggressive and set per-session KV cap to 8k tokens as emergency stopgap.
Samir Patel: Preparing rollout. Will patch the runtime config via ssm on the hosted pool. Command: ```ssh infra@host 'sudo systemctl reload redwood-runtime && export PREFETCH_MAX_SESSIONS=200'``` (will use config agent to apply centrally).
infra-bot: Deploy request received. Starting canary rollout to 10% of hosts (h1-h3).
Lina (CXS): We have reports from two customers seeing 502s and degraded responses since ~10:02. Gathering request IDs and sessions now. Keeping them updated.
ops-oncall: Noted customer IDs: cust-827, cust-1124. Marking as potentially impacted. Created escalation group and pinged account team.
Samir Patel: Canary patch applied to hosts h1-h3 — memory on those hosts dropped from 92% -> 46% within 90s. No immediate errors in canary logs.
Marco Li: Good signal. Memory trend flattened on canary. However, continuous-batching disabled for that route increased tail latency by ~30ms and throughput down ~8%. Acceptable for emergency.
Priya Rao: OK to push to 100% with 10s stagger if infra is confident. Please monitor KV hit/miss, mem, and error rate dashboards.
infra-bot: Rolling to remaining hosts with 10s stagger. Currently at 60%.
Samir Patel: Push complete. All hosts have emergency config applied. Memory across pool back to expected baselines.
Lina (CXS): Confirmed customer cust-827 and cust-1124 error rates dropped after patch. They're pleased with the quick response but want RCA and ETA to revert to non-throttled behavior.
Marco Li: Follow-ups: 1) Reproduce batching regression in unit/integration tests, 2) Add adaptive prefetch rate-limiter to runtime, 3) Add per-session KV caps enforced at prefetch time, 4) Run load test with long-prompt tails to validate.
Priya Rao: Creating INC ticket INC-2025-4990 and stub of postmortem. Assigning action items: Samir -> hotfix rollout notes + config patch doc, Marco -> perf/regression triage, Ops -> postmortem timeline, CXS -> customer comms.
ops-oncall: Updating status: incident severity lowered to Sev2. Keeping channel open for 1 hour for validation.
incident-bot: Incident updated: severity -> Sev2, handlers: Priya Rao, Samir Patel, Marco Li.
Samir Patel: Adding notes to runbook: emergency env vars and rollback commands: ```/opt/redwood/bin/runtimectl set PREFETCH_MAX_SESSIONS=200; /opt/redwood/bin/runtimectl set BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=2048; /opt/redwood/bin/runtimectl set EVICTION_POLICY=aggressive```
Marco Li: Also adding a perf test that pumps long multi-document prompts to ensure KV growth is bounded.
Priya Rao: Final note: We'll keep the throttles for the next 24h while we validate. Postmortem + customer follow-ups due EOD tomorrow.
Lina (CXS): Sharing a short template to update customers. Will post copies here when ready. :email:
ops-oncall: Thanks team. Marking this thread for handoff to oncall rotation in 30m.
incident-bot: Thread closed for active mitigation; monitoring phase engaged. Record: INC-2025-4990.
